records.claim: Applicants for a Finnish residence permit for studies must have been accepted by a Finnish educational institution; eligible studies generally lead to a degree or vocational qualification, with exchange study also covered. The studies must require residence in Finland rather than mainly being online distance learning.
records.methodology: Direct review of current Finnish Immigration Service study residence-permit guidance; route-scoped to FI-study.

records.claim: Applicants for a first Finnish study residence permit need at least EUR 800 per month for living costs; for studies lasting at least one year, the guidance states EUR 9,600 must be available when applying, in addition to funds needed for unpaid tuition fees where applicable.
records.methodology: Direct review of current Finnish Immigration Service student income-requirement guidance; route-scoped to FI-study and does not infer tuition costs.
